name: Nexus Collections Command Centre
description: A clickable AI collections command centre for lenders: overview, work queue, case view, live calls, audit trail, a guided tour and role-based views. Front end only, with illustrative data.
features: Prioritised work queue with risk scores and reasons
Case view with drafted multilingual messages and approvals
Live AI call console with scripted transcripts
Collections Officer, Collections Manager, Head of Collections, Internal Audit, and Admin views
Data sources, rules and model screens
